_help: Edit the 'text' of any line to change what the caller hears. To use YOUR OWN VOICE instead of the computer voice, record the line, save it as an MP3 in public/audio/ using the file name shown in 'audio', and it will be played automatically. Missing audio files fall back to the computer voice reading 'text'. 'website' is the key that texts the caller a link to the website. 'sms' holds those text messages ({link} and {service} are filled in automatically). 'questions' are asked one by one after the caller picks a service: add, remove or reorder them freely ('label' is the short name shown in your dashboard, 'maxSeconds' is how long they can answer). See VOICE-SCRIPT.md.

greeting.text: Hello! This is a call from Selfie TV Boss Entertainment. We saw that you're promoting a party or event, or looking for a host, and we'd love to help make it a big success. Selfie TV Boss is a professional event host, D J, entertainer, movie actor, project manager and promoter.

inboundGreeting.text: Thank you for calling Selfie TV Boss Entertainment, the host that makes your event go live!

menu.text: For project managing, press 1. For hosting your show or event, press 2. For D J services, press 3. For entertainment, press 4. For movie acting and on-camera work, press 5. For promotions, press 6. To get a text message with a link to our website, where you can see everything we offer and book online, press 7. To speak with Selfie TV Boss now, press 0. To hear these options again, press star.

noInput.text: Sorry, we didn't get a choice.

invalid.text: Sorry, that's not one of the options.

linkSent.text: We've also sent you a text message with a link to book online, so you can check out everything Selfie TV Boss offers.

questionsIntro.text: We just have a few quick questions so Selfie TV Boss can get back to you with the right package. Answer each one after the beep, then press the pound key.

thanks.text: Thank you! Selfie TV Boss will call you back very soon. You can also book online at selfie T V boss dot com. Have a great day!

connecting.text: Please hold while we connect you to Selfie TV Boss.

ownerUnavailable.text: Selfie TV Boss can't take the call right now, but he'll call you right back.

goodbye.text: Thanks for your time. To book Selfie TV Boss, visit selfie T V boss dot com. Goodbye!

voicemail.text: Hi, this is Selfie TV Boss Entertainment. We saw you're promoting a party or event, and we'd love to help, whether you need a host, a D J, an entertainer, promotions or full project management. Call us back at this number, or visit selfie T V boss dot com to book online. Thanks!

website.text: Perfect! We've just sent you a text message with a link to our website. Tap it to see Selfie TV Boss in action, check upcoming events, and book online any time. Thanks for your time, and have a great day!
